name: Tsubata Kyouko
source:
Kazumi's only daughter. She is a college student. She has been supporting her mother, who is a bit of a loose cannon, so she has a strong personality. 

She is usually friendly, but she is a mess when it comes to sexual matters. The reason for this is that she was once almost assaulted by a man. She wants to be with the main character, but this trauma makes it difficult for her to accept it.

[From [url=https://www.ume.gr.jp/product/ume/kazumi1/kazumi1.html]official site[/url]]
